description:
Backend-impl slice of JMAP-g7wu.2.4: implement AddCategory/RemoveCategory/UpdateCategory variants in MemoryBackend::apply_space_patch.

Cascading semantics for RemoveCategory:
- Channels currently in removed categories move to uncategorizedChannelIds (draft §Space/set line 1126).
- For each removed CategoryId, find all Channels with that category and update their category reference to uncategorized.

ULID assignment for AddCategory: generate new CategoryId.

Depends on .4.1 (SpacePatchOp enum) landing. Parallelizable with .4.3 (roles+members) and .4.4 (channels) — different match arms.
title: apply_space_patch MemoryBackend: Category variants (with Channel reassignment cascade)
